title: Enter the Warren
body: Every worker is a creature, and food is the power grid. Drag the map to look around. Tap + or − to zoom.

title: Stabilize the Food Grid
body: Read Food Grid: keep Production above Upkeep. Tap Farm, then open floor. Wait for Farm construction. If food pressure rises, use the visible Jobs controls to move a worker to Carrier or Cook.

title: Close the Living Factory Loop
body: Tap the existing Mine to read its rate. Place a Blacksmith. Use the visible Jobs controls to staff Smith if needed. Tap Blacksmith, then Iron Pickaxe; the miner equips it and the Mine speeds up.

title: Secure the Warren
body: Deliver 50 ore and hold 100 food in Objective. Before a raid, use the visible − and + controls beside Guard in Jobs; the Objective names the safe worker to move first. This secures the warren and ends onboarding; next, forge 20 ingots and raise the Shrine.

title: Awaken the Worm
body: Tap the Worm Shrine to inspect it. Keep its offerings running: the panel shows food and ingot progress, reserves, and blockers. Feed the Colossal Worm sleeping below. This tutorial completes when the worm awakens.
